item.stem:
The diagram shows quadrilateral $ABCD$ with all four angles $90^\circ$ and side lengths $6$, $4$, $6$, $4$ in order around the shape.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Call it a square as the label, with no check that all sides are equal.
options.B: Being a square is what produces the four right angles here.
options.C: It is a rectangle but not a square, because all angles are right while adjacent sides $6$ and $4$ are unequal.
options.D: Report $6$ as the type, because that numeral is printed first on a side.
